lines.2: Without thinking, I turned toward the sea and opened my mouth.
lines.4: 「Wha-- What are you shouting for? That's embarrassing.」
lines.7: 「And there's one thing I should tell you.」
lines.11: That hit me right in the heart.
lines.16: 「...Princess, did you really place first on the nationwide mock exam?」
lines.18: I was all fired up now.
lines.21: 「Oh. Right, now that you mention it.」
lines.24: 「But I know it'd be your first time, Princess, so I won't pressure you.」
lines.25: 「It wouldn't be my first. Would you stop underestimating me?」
lines.26: 「R-Really? So I'm the only one who hasn't...」
lines.27: 「I'm nervous, but... would that be all right?」
lines.29: 「Then again, mine was with Yoppi, so it hardly counts.」
lines.31: I put a hand on the Princess's shoulder.
lines.32: Her shoulder was soft and slender.
lines.33: She might train, but the Princess was still a girl after all.
lines.38: She rose onto her toes and kissed me herself.
lines.39: Even here, she refused to play the passive role.
lines.40: Our lips met lightly, just once--
lines.42: My heart gave a violent thump, and I couldn't even register the taste.
lines.43: 「...That was incredible, but... I couldn't really tell what happened.」
lines.44: 「Mm... It didn't exactly feel good or anything.」
lines.45: 「It's more like my heart is tingling.」
lines.48: 「Can we do that one more time?」
lines.50: 「...Then, want to come to my place? Otome's visiting her family, so nobody's home.」
lines.55: I was clutching the Princess's hand.
lines.57: But I wanted her to come.
lines.58: So I squeezed her soft hand tight.
lines.59: Maybe she understood what I meant.
lines.61: The Princess agreed to come to my room.
lines.66: 「Hey! You're not the one who gets to say that!」
lines.67: She fired a sharp retort straight back.
lines.69: I had to pull myself together.
lines.72: The Princess was walking beside me.
lines.73: A beauty every man we passed stole a glance at.
